title.zh: Sui Devnet新增后量子签名支持，目标2027年一季度主网上线
title.en: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20

current_state.zh: Sui Devnet 已在 v1.82.0（报道称为协议版本 139）中加入 ML-DSA-65 原生账户签名方案，并完成首笔原生抗量子交易；测试网目标为 2026 年底，主网目标为 2027 年 Q1，以独立审计和测试网反馈为准。
current_state.en: Sui Devnet has added ML-DSA-65 as a native account signature scheme (reported as protocol version 139) and processed its first native post-quantum transaction; Testnet is targeted for end-2026 and Mainnet for Q1 2027, subject to independent audits and Testnet feedback.

updates.title_en: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20
updates.what_changed_zh: Mysten Labs为Sui Devnet v1.82.0添加了ML-DSA-65后量子签名支持，通过其ExecuteTransaction和VerifySignature API处理了该网络的首笔量子安全交易，测试网预计在2026年底上线，原生主网账户认证目标为2027年一季度。
updates.what_changed_en: Mysten Labs added ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signature support to Sui Devnet v1.82.0, processing the network's first quantum-safe transaction via its ExecuteTransaction and VerifySignature APIs, with Testnet expected by end-2026 and native Mainnet account authentication targeted for Q1 2027.

updates.title_zh: 【Sui Devnet 完成首笔原生抗量子交易，目标 2027 年 Q1 上线主网】
updates.title_en: 【Sui Devnet 完成首笔原生抗量子交易，目标 2027 年 Q1 上线主网】
updates.what_changed_zh: 后续报道确认 ML-DSA-65 在 Devnet 协议版本 139 中作为原生账户签名方案加入，单签和多签账户均支持，验证者可验证后量子密钥授权交易；测试网和主网目前仍不接受此类签名，主网时间取决于独立审计和测试网反馈。
updates.what_changed_en: Follow-up reporting confirms ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in Devnet protocol version 139, supporting single- and multi-signature accounts, with validators able to verify transactions authorized by post-quantum keys; Testnet and Mainnet still do not accept such signatures, and Mainnet timing depends on independent audits and Testnet feedback.
updates.current_state_zh: Sui Devnet 已在 v1.82.0（报道称为协议版本 139）中加入 ML-DSA-65 原生账户签名方案，并完成首笔原生抗量子交易；测试网目标为 2026 年底，主网目标为 2027 年 Q1，以独立审计和测试网反馈为准。
updates.current_state_en: Sui Devnet has added ML-DSA-65 as a native account signature scheme (reported as protocol version 139) and processed its first native post-quantum transaction; Testnet is targeted for end-2026 and Mainnet for Q1 2027, subject to independent audits and Testnet feedback.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Mysten Labs' Kostas Chalkias said Sui Devnet has processed the first native post-quantum transaction after ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in protocol version 139, ahead of a testnet target by end-2026 and mainnet in Q1 2027 subject to audits.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mysten Labs' Kostas Chalkias said Sui Devnet has processed the first native post-quantum transaction after ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in protocol version 139, ahead of a testnet target by end-2026 and mainnet in Q1 2027 subject to audits.
